LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacEmitter.label: aphrodisiac emitter
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacEmitter.description: Electricity sustains semi-permanent mist production from a PNA–humpshroom mixture. Uses the humpshroom effect defined by the current mod environment.\n\nDirect player switch; radius 5–20, default 10. Power demand is 100 + 4 × radius² W. Only affects targets within the radius and in the same room. Existing drug effects wear off normally after exposure ends. PNA and humpshroom are consumed only during construction.
